'''Ziton Moj''' was the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]] for [[Xomit Grunseit/Legends|Xomit Grunseit's]] faction of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], he joined [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|It would seem the decision to join us is now yours.''"<br />"''After careful consideration, we will join you.|[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and Ziton Moj|<ref name="Eminence (episode)" />}}
[[File:Moj-TakeoverOnMandalore.png|thumb|left|250px|Moj leads his team during the Takeover on Mandalore.]]
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] came to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] where Moj was stationed with the rest of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] faction. The Death Watch, led by [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] met Moj at the front of the facility. Maul requested an audience with his leader, [[Xomit Grunseit/Legends|Xomit Grunseit]]. Moj led them there where they met with Grunseit. Maul attempted to sway the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] to his side, but Grunseit refused. As a result of this, Opress killed him, along with all the other members of Black Sun in the room. Moj, meanwhile, decided to ally with Maul.

Now allied with Maul's [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]], Moj would travel with Maul and Opress as they searched for people to rally. A short time later, he was present for a briefing session where holographic images of the city were analyzed, in order for them to attack the city in the right places. In the [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|takeover]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], Moj's job was to cause disruption throughout the city as per the plan devised by Maul and Pre Vizsla. Moj first attacked the [[Sundari shipping docks/Legends|Sundari shipping docks]], where the gangsters first entered Sundari, and then moved on to wreak havoc in [[Peace Park/Legends|Peace Park]]. Moj's team was ultimately "stopped" by Death Watch forces led by [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan Kryze]], and he was presented to the people of Sundari as a prisoner.
